content.text: An object field groups fields and stores their values together as one object. Use it for data that belongs together, like an address or a call to action, and to reuse such a group in several types.
`fields` (required): the fields of the object, keyed by name. Any field type works, including lists and other objects.

An object with a key per field: `{street: '', zip: '', city: ''}`. New entries start with the initial values of the inner fields. Link and image fields inside the object are resolved when you query it, just like at the top level.
Select and sort on the object as a whole: the inner fields aren't registered in the schema, so `Venue.address.city` can't be used in `select` or `orderBy`. To filter on an inner value, use `has`:
